topics.title: SEBI Just Changed Mutual Fund Rules — What It Actually Means For Your Money
topics.angle: Break down the new SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations 2026 (effective April 1) in plain language — what's the base expense ratio change, why brokerage limits got halved, and how this saves the average SIP investor real money over time
topics.trend_context: SEBI approved new MF regulations replacing 30-year-old 1996 rules; expense ratio restructured with new BER concept; brokerage limits cut from 12bps to 6bps; takes effect April 1, 2026
topics.general_hook: Your Sensex is down 10% this year and everyone's panicking — but while you're watching red screens, SEBI quietly made a change that could save you lakhs over your investing lifetime

topics.title: RBI's New Zero-Balance Account Rules — Free Banking Most Indians Don't Know About
topics.angle: Explain the April 2026 BSBD account overhaul — unlimited free UPI/NEFT/RTGS, free debit card, free chequebook — and why this is a game-changer for anyone still paying bank charges they shouldn't be
topics.trend_context: RBI announced major BSBD upgrade: unlimited free digital transactions, free debit card issuance and renewal, free internet/mobile banking, positioned as normal banking for all customers from April 1, 2026
topics.general_hook: LPG prices are up, petrol is up, everything costs more — but your bank just got ordered to stop charging you for basic stuff you've been paying for this whole time
